messages:
incident-bot: [AUTO] High error rate detected on route 'embeddings' (QPS spike). p95 latency 1.6s, errors 4%. Suggested mitigations: per-route QPS carve, prioritize chat for enterprise, disable optional rerank for non-enterprise. Paging @jordan-oncall
jordan-oncall: ack I'm on it, looking at dashboards
jordan-oncall: embedding QPS spiked ~3x from baseline. Alerts show backlog on inference queue and increased KV-cache churn
sam-ml: logs show large batch uploads from tenant 'searchly' starting ~02:12 UTC, looks like a misconfigured bulk embed job
jordan-oncall: mitigation plan:
1) reduce embeddings route QPS by ~35% (soft carve)
2) increase chat route share for enterprise routes (+15%)
3) temporarily disable rerank on non-enterprise routes
4) enable conservative prefix cache TTL=30s for embeddings
5) notify support and affected customers
liz-ops: executing carve now
liz-ops: ```
# carve embeddings qps 35% (soft)
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/quotas" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"route":"embeddings","qps_factor":0.65,"reason":"live-mitigation-5112233344"}'
```
bkumar-runtime: confirmed: embeddings qps set to 65% of baseline, chat bump applied to enterprise slice, rerank flag toggled OFF on non-ent routes
support-bot: Support ticket INC-2024-789 created. Affected customers: searchly, docbot, edu-labs. Account teams notified.
maria-sre: monitoring update (10m): errors down to ~1.1%, p95 embeddings ~0.9s — latency trending down
jordan-oncall: handing off active monitoring to maria-sre for next 120m. Maria please own follow-up, coordinate with runtime to tune rate-limiter buckets and batching windows, and prepare customer-impact summary
maria-sre: ack, will keep an eye on error budgets, run a safe rollback window at +30m if we see regressions, and draft a short post-incident note with timestamps and impacted tenant counts
sam-ml: FYI reached out to searchly product contact; they confirmed a mis-scheduled bulk job and will pause while we stabilize
liz-ops: rerank remains disabled for non-enterprise. Plan: re-enable in a staggered canary for top-5 customers after 1h stable and a smoke test
jordan-oncall: created incident doc /incidents/5112233344 and filed follow-up tasks for eng-runtime (rate-limiter tuning), eng-ml (batching safeguards), and support (customer comms). Closing on-call loop :white_check_mark:
